item.title: Police searching for offender who sexually assaulted Alice Springs woman
item.description: NT Police are searching for a man who allegedly sexually assaulted a woman in her 20s early Sunday morning on a street in Alice Springs, before stealing the woman's handbag and fleeing the scene, but did not provide a description.

item.title: Pastoral company pays more than $300 million for Beetaloo stations
item.description: Consolidated Pastoral Company has acquired the Beetaloo aggregation of stations in the NT for more than $300 million, making it the largest pastoral sale in the Territory's history.

item.title: Man charged with murder over Borroloola domestic violence death
item.description: A 27-year-old man has been charged with murder in relation to the suspicious death of his female partner 10 days ago, NT Police said.

item.title: Public servants vote to accept EBA offer after above-cap wage increase
item.description: Public servants have voted to accept the Finocchiaro CLP Government's latest pay offer, ending drawn out negotiations over the 2025-2029 enterprise bargaining agreement.

item.title: Tree removal company fined after smoking employees caused ‘fireball’ incident while refuelling vehicle
item.description: A Darwin-based tree services company has been fined $10,000 following a serious workplace incident that involved an employee attempting to light a cigarette for another worker who was refuelling a work vehicle, causing a fireball that engulfed the vehicle and injured the employee.

item.title: NT Criminal Court list – with charges – Dec 18
item.description: The 231 names facing criminal courts in the Northern Territory for Thursday, December 18, 2025. This list includes all the charges.

item.title: ‘Misleading, inaccurate, and potentially defamatory’: Researchers reject government’s criticism of water study
item.description: A team of scientists say the NT Government is being "misleading, inaccurate and potentially defamatory" by claiming their study that found a major aquifer was drying at an accelerated pace did not include enough years of data, a criticism that follows the government itself in 2022 inexplicably doubling the estimated annual re-filling rate provided for an aquifer by appearing to cut the data period in half.

item.title: Man charged with murder over suspicious 2022 death of woman in Katherine
item.description: A 47-year-old man has been charged with murder following a more than three-year-long investigation into the suspicious death of a woman who was first found unconscious on a Katherine street corner in August 2022.

item.title: Where did Darwin Council’s $125k for city Christmas decorations go?
item.description: Darwin Council will not say if it spent the $126,500 allocated for the annual city Christmas display, that this year involves failing lights, decorations from Christmases long, long ago, and the old Smith Street Christmas tree that appears was only lit for one night.

item.title: $500,000 reward for information that leads police to Angie Fuller
item.description: The reward for information that leads to police finding missing woman Angie Fuller has been doubled to $500,000, NT Police said.
